newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota water chief jailed for pipe repair delays.
newsitem.headline: Bogota water chief jailed for pipe repair delays.

text.p: The head of Bogota's water company will go to jail for not repairing broken pipes on time in a working class district of the capital, officials said on Wednesday.
Alejandro Deeb, general manager of the Bogota Aqueduct and Drainage Company, will be suspended from his post on Thursday to begin a two-week spell behind bars ordered by a judge.

"Deeb fully respects the judge's ruling but in personal terms it will be difficult for him to explain this to his children and he is going to find it hard being away from his family for two weeks," a water company spokesman said.
The judge ordered Deeb's jailing after he failed to comply with an earlier court ruling to speed up waterpipe repairs in the south of the city.
A homeowner complained the work was damaging her house and won an order obliging the public utility to finish the job within two months -- it took more than twice that time.
